summary: First iteration. Comprehensive backend (27 pytest cases) + frontend smoke tests on Agro CRM. Backend: 27/27 passing (100%) covering health, JWT auth (login/me/refresh), full CRUD on clients (create→get→patch→soft-delete with persistence verification), pipeline board+move+interaction, contracts, orders (PATCH status), products, logistics, support, dashboard KPIs, GPT-5.2 AI agents (marketing analyze-client, sales summarize-opportunity, channel chat session+message), sync info/pull/push, integrations connectors+webhook, audit. Frontend: login → dashboard works, all 10 sidebar nav items navigate (Dashboard, Clientes, Pipeline, Contratos, Pedidos, Produtos, Logística, Suporte, Agentes IA, Arquitetura), 4 dashboard KPIs render with correct values, pipeline kanban renders 5 stages with opportunities + Resumo IA buttons, products grid (6 cards), AI agents page (3 agent cards + chat panel), Architecture (4 telemetry cards + 7 sections + ASCII diagram). No JS console errors, no page errors. user 'Carlos Andrade' shown.

minor.issue: No dedicated /advance endpoint exists; status advancement is done via generic PATCH with {status}. Original requirement mentioned 'Avançar status' button — this works via PATCH but a convenience POST /advance with state-machine logic may be desirable.

ui_bugs.issue: Top portion of KPI cards has a fade/gradient overlay that visually clips the labels (CONTRATOS ATIVOS, PIPELINE TOTAL, etc.) and value lines, reducing legibility on first paint. Numbers themselves are readable but title strip looks washed.
Donut chart area appears empty in the dashboard screenshot — only the bottom legend (Queue 1, In Transit 1, Delivered 1) renders. The actual donut SVG seems missing or 0-sized.

issues: Donut chart not visually rendered (only legend)
KPI label text partially obscured by gradient

action_items: Investigate and fix Dashboard donut chart for logistic_status — appears empty (likely Recharts ResponsiveContainer height=0 or data shape mismatch).
Review Dashboard KPI card top overlay/gradient — labels look faded/clipped.
(Optional) Implement explicit POST /api/orders/{id}/advance with state-machine to formalize 'Avançar status' UX (currently relies on generic PATCH).
critical_code_review_comments: Pipeline interaction model uses field 'notes' instead of 'content' — fine, but document in API spec.
GET /api/pipeline/board returns object {stages, total_value, total_opportunities} (not list). Confirm frontend Pipeline.jsx consumes this shape correctly.
Soft-delete confirmed working on /api/clients (deleted_at set, removed from list). Good.
GPT-5.2 AI calls (marketing/sales/channel) all respond within ~5–15s — acceptable.
All endpoints under /api prefix; CORS/JWT functional; tenant_id default isolation in place.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing seed (5 clients, 6 products, 5 stages/opps, 4 contracts, 3 orders, 3 cargas, 3 vehicles, 3 tickets). TEST_ prefixed clients created during pytest are soft-deleted by tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the canonical regression. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. AI tests take ~25-35s total due to live GPT-5.2 calls. Pipeline board returns dict {stages: [...]}, NOT a list — note for frontend tests. Orders advance is PATCH /api/orders/{id} with {status}, no /advance endpoint exists. Sync push payload format: {device_id, records:[{entity, op:'upsert', data:{id,...,tenant_id}}]}. Connectors response: {connectors:[{name,type,...}]}. Drag&drop in Pipeline UI not Playwright-tested; API-level move endpoint verified. Visual issues found: (a) dashboard KPI label fade overlay, (b) logistic donut chart area appears empty.
rca of the issue: Donut chart issue likely due to Recharts ResponsiveContainer with parent height not set, or empty data array when logistic_status counts are uniform — main agent should inspect /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx donut PieChart usage. KPI fade is likely a CSS gradient overlay (::before pseudo-element) bleeding over title text — lower opacity or change z-index/color stops.
